    sql_query = f"""
    SELECT printf('%.{precision}f', CAST(SUM(\"Amount Including Tax\") AS NUMERIC))

    """
    sql_sum_result = pd.read_sql(sql_query, conn).iloc[0, 0]

    getcontext().prec = precision
    data_query = "SELECT \"Amount Including Tax\" FROM nch___sales_invoices"
    df_values = pd.read_sql(data_query, conn)
